title: Simulation 3D Trailer
text: 在 3D 环境中实现挂车，输入 2 路；按 {Type} 指定拖车类型 Two-axle；{Name} 指定车辆名称 SimulinkVehicle1、{Initial array values to translate vehicle per part, Translation} 指定车辆初始平移 zeros、{Initial array values to rotate vehicle per part, Rotation} 指定车辆初始旋转 zeros、{Sample time} 指定采样时间，按实例取值。

ports.name: Translation
ports.summary: 车辆平移 5 -by- 3 array (default) | 7 -by- 3 array | 3 -by- 3 array

ports.name: Rotation
ports.summary: 车辆旋转 5 -by- 3 array (default) | 7 -by- 3 array | 3 -by- 3 array

params.name: Type
params.values: 拖车类型 Two-axle trailer (default) | Three-axle trailer | One-axle trailer

params.name: Name
params.values: 车辆名称 SimulinkVehicle1 (default) | character vector

params.name: Initial array values to translate vehicle per part, Translation
params.values: 车辆初始平移 zeros( 5, 3 ) (default) | zeros( 7, 3 ) | zeros( 3, 3 )

params.name: Initial array values to rotate vehicle per part, Rotation
params.values: 车辆初始旋转 zeros( 5, 3 ) (default) | zeros( 7, 3 ) | zeros( 3, 3 )
